id: AT-VD-05 (visible defaults: settings reset dry run)
note: 0.1.2 visible defaults (spec Behaviour 4): `settings reset <key>…|--all` without --apply is a dry run of the settings writer, like `project copy`: it lists exactly the members it would remove as old -> default (never the ticket pattern's or a list's text: built-in or custom, an entry count), names those not saved, and ends with the line that applies it, which carries --plan (the first 12 hex of the file's sha-256) so the apply refuses a file that changed since. The settings file keeps its bytes and mtime; no backup is written. --all leaves out the ten consent and protective keys (OPEN-2, the spec's recommendation) and says which it kept. A consent key named is refused (the writer never writes one), and so is a protective list or resume_proceed whose removal loosens it. An unknown key, no key and a key with --all are usage errors.

steps.name: one key and one not saved

stdout_has: \Asettings reset: dry run, nothing written · ~/\.claude/settings\.json · plugin options under "$BRAND@m"$
^  not saved, nothing to remove: cooldown_ms$

steps.name: --all: every saved key but the consent and protective ones; nothing echoed

stdout_has: ^  would change ticket_pattern: custom -> default built-in \(removed\)$
^  would change watcher: false -> default true \(removed\)$

^  kept by --all \(consent or protective: the writer never writes a consent key, never takes an entry from a protective list and never moves resume_proceed back to true; change those in /config or the file by hand\): relaunch_auto, secret_extra_rules, resume_proceed$

steps.name: a consent key named: refused, nothing written (the writer never writes one)

stdout_has: ^  relaunch_auto: a consent key; the plugin never writes it, whoever runs this\. Change it yourself in /config \(the row $BRAND\.relaunch_auto\) or in your settings\.json by hand$

steps.name: a protective list and resume_proceed named: their removal loosens them, refused

stdout_has: ^  secret_extra_rules: looser, refused: a protective list only gains entries here; 1 of its saved entries would go$
^  resume_proceed: looser, refused: it only goes towards false here \(saved false\)$

stderr_has: ^usage: settings reset: no_such_key is no setting of this plugin$
^usage: settings show \| settings set <key>=<value>\.\.\. \[--apply\] \| settings reset <key>\.\.\.\|--all \[--apply\] \| settings migrate \[--apply\]$

steps.name: nothing saved for the plugin: nothing to remove

stdout_has: ^settings reset: nothing to remove \(no plugin options in ~/\.claude/settings\.json\)$
